ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: On invalid Content-Length in get_incoming, restore the BufReader's inner stream back into self.stream before returning Err(Error::Header), so a subsequent close_connection / into_inner does not panic because the underlying NetworkStream was dropped on the error path.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title 'fix(http): Make sure not to lose the stream when CL is invalid' and body: 'When the Content-Length header is invalid, the Http11Message ends up dropping the stream before returning the error. This causes a panic when the close_connection method of the message is used later. This commit fixes this by saving the stream onto the message instance before returning the error. A regression test is also included. Closes #646.'

ai_baseline.notes: Rank 1 directly identifies the stream restore before Err(Error::Header) and the close_connection / into_inner panic avoidance — matches PR intent. Rank 2 correctly tags the regression test as supporting.
